thread:
Maya: heads-up — prod-east is showing repeated p95 latency SLO misses for model-r10 on burst traffic. alerts started ~10:18 UTC. p95 jumped from ~140ms to ~320ms when qps > 480 :alarm_clock:
Samir: thanks. do we have batching stats? are we seeing big full batches delaying small requests?
Jin: looks like continuous batching pressure. packing window is 8ms, max_batch_size is 128. when traffic is spiky many requests sit waiting for batch to fill and then hit GPU admission limits. partial-release is off for this model.
Lina: ops-bot fired this alert: 
ops-bot: [ALERT] prod-east model-r10: p95 latency 320ms (>150ms SLO) for 5m, queue_depth high on shard-3.
Owen: can we confirm if this is max_batch_size causing queuing, or GPU admission saturation (QPS per GPU)?
Jin: both. admission is capping outstanding batches per GPU at 10, and because batches are large we get head-of-line waits. throughput is fine but tail gets hammered. logs show many "batch_wait_ms" values ~120-200ms.
Samir: snippet from the runtime metrics: 
```
model: model-r10
pack_window_ms: 8
max_batch_size: 128
gpu_admission_limit: 10
p95_latency_ms: 320
queue_depth: 18
```
Maya: tradeoff: lowering max_batch_size reduces individual batch efficiency (more kernel launches) but improves latency. adding GPUs would fix throughput but costs money and takes time.
Lina: can we do a quick config rollback to a more latency-friendly profile for prod-east for model-r10? maybe `max_batch_size: 64` + enable partial-release?
Owen: +1. also consider per-shard qps caps to avoid coord hot-shards. we can set `admission_qps = 480` per-shard as a short-term throttle.
Samir: if we drop to 64, estimate p95 should fall under 160ms from past sim runs. cost impact: ~6% higher token cost due to smaller batches (more kernel overhead).
Jin: I'll prepare a short live patch for the runtime config: 
```
- models/model-r10/prod-east:
    max_batch_size: 64
    partial_release: true
    admission_qps_per_shard: 480
```
Lina: how quick to deploy? can we hot-reload configs?
Jin: yes, hot-reload possible. will push to canary shard-1 in 5m, observe for 10m, then rollout if stable.
Maya: plan: Jin -> canary patch -> monitor p95 and queue_depth. Owen -> set temporary admission qps on hot-shards. Samir -> update runbook cost note (6% unit cost hit). Lina -> prep rollback steps.
Owen: one more ask — let's add a metric for `batch_wait_ms` to alert if >50ms for more than 3m. reduces alert noise and gives earlier signal.
Maya: agreed. action items captured. FYI we should discuss longer-term: enable adaptive max_batch sizing by traffic shape or enable more aggressive partial_release heuristics so we don't have to manually tune per model/region.
Samir: noted. opening a follow-up ticket to evaluate adaptive batching vs modest overprovisioning economics.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] config hot-reload started for models/model-r10/prod-east (canary shard-1).
Jin: canary looks good so far — p95 down to 145ms after 4m, queue_depth dropped to 6. proceeding to rollout to other shards in 2m.
Maya: thanks team. keep the channel updated if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
